content: MS Vahid Paşa 621 (Kütahya, copied 10 Dhū l-Qaʿda 868/15 July 1464) contains Yazdī's preface (dated 830/1427) for his brother Qivām al-Dīn's dīvān and 'assorted correspondence with various Timurid notables, including seven letters or incidental material concerning Ibn Turka or the members of his family'; the older Revan 1019 (copied 27 Shaʿbān 867/17 May 1463) is very similar but MK could not examine it.
